title: Switch logins
intro: Logins Floorbit uses for port actions, switch commands and the terminal, so the crew doesn't type one each time. Encrypted, and never shown again once set.
empty: No logins stored: each tech types their own switch login.
removeQuestion: Remove the login for {{scope}}? Techs then type their own for those switches.
scopeHint: * for every switch, a pattern like sw-a-*, or one switch name
how: The most specific login wins: one switch's own, then the longest pattern, then *. With a login for *, pages stop asking for one. Every use is in the audit log.
